title: Montana Mountain Rider Travel Poster
coreRelationships: The rider and horse are a small, dark silhouette against the lighter mountain and sky, emphasizing scale.
The jagged peaks of the mountains contrast with the smooth, flat orange sky.
The dark foreground elements (rider, trees) create a strong visual base for the lighter, more detailed mountains.
The angular shapes of the mountains are echoed in the sharp edges of the pine trees.
The text at the bottom is a distinct, rectangular block that anchors the entire composition.
reuseFormula: Recreate the scene with a rider on horseback in the lower left, facing right, silhouetted against a multi-layered mountain range. Use sharp, angular shapes for the mountains, employing a limited palette of dark grays/purples for shadows, white/light gray for snow/highlights, and a solid, warm color for the sky. Include a dark, jagged line of pine trees between the rider and the mountains. Place bold, sans-serif text at the bottom. Ensure high contrast and a minimalist, flat-color aesthetic.
